name: nullpii
description: Masks personal data and secrets in prompts and tool results before Claude reads them, using a local nullpii sidecar, and shows what it masked above the prompt

sidecar_token.title: Sidecar token
sidecar_token.description: The NULLPII_SIDECAR_TOKEN that nullpii-gateway was started with. Stored in secure storage and not exported to the commands Claude runs.

sidecar_url.title: Sidecar URL
sidecar_url.description: Where nullpii-gateway listens: http:// on 127.0.0.1 or [::1], the literal address the gateway listens on, with an optional port. Any other address, localhost included, is refused.

autostart.title: Start the sidecar
autostart.description: When no nullpii-gateway answers at the sidecar URL, start one for the session (npx with this release's packages; its first start downloads the model). It uses the sidecar token above and stops with the session.

while_starting.title: While nullpii starts
while_starting.description: What happens to a prompt you send while the sidecar this session started is still coming up (its first start downloads the model): ask (the default: wait for nullpii, or send it now unprotected), block (always wait), or pass (always send it unprotected, with the band saying so).
